description: Schema-4 rules drafts of all 303 counted Artifact Classic cards (EFFECT_SYSTEM_SPEC.md, Coverage fixes C.1). Every entry is status draft and validates with scripts/core/rules/rules_db.gd (tests/rules_schema_test.gd). tools/new_card.py copies an entry into data/classic_cards.json; milestones M3 to M7 verify them card by card.
